top_signals.title: Justifying Anthropic’s Valuation, The Bank of Nvidia
top_signals.summary: A weekly, midday program that delivers high-impact, editorially driven coverage of the most important corporate transactions shaping the global market. Today's guests: Goldman Sachs Global Head of Asset & Wealth Management Marc Nachmann Battery Ventures General Partner Dharmesh Thakker, and Citi Executive Vice Chair & Head Banking Vis Raghavan. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: US Carrier Sails From Persian Gulf, Leaving Two in Region
top_signals.summary: One of three US aircraft carrier strike groups in the Persian Gulf region to enforce the naval blockade against Iran has left the region and is likely returning to its home port, according to two US officials.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
